clips.title: The story
paras: On Brightwater Lake's island, a spellbook draws Bethor Iceshard's attention. He hopes its pages will reveal the lich's skill and who he was in life.

A free-willed lich guards an island in Brightwater Lake with skeletal minions. He distrusts the outside world and mistakes other undead for Scourge thralls, ordering his guardians to kill anyone who approaches. Bethor Iceshard seeks skilled necromancers for the Forsaken beneath Queen Sylvanas Windrunner. He sends an emissary into the island camp to take the lich's spellbook. Bethor hopes its pages will reveal the master's power and identity before death took Lordaeron.
